newsitem.title: USA: Culp to buy fabric businesses for $47 mln. [CORRECTED 18:31 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Culp to buy fabric businesses for $47 mln. [CORRECTED 18:31 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline to read $47 million instead of $43 million.)
Culp Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a letter of intent to acquire four upholstery fabric businesses owned by privately held Phillips Industries Inc for $47 million in cash and notes.
The units involved are Phillips Weaving Mills, Phillips Velvet Mills, Phillips Printing and Phillips Mills.
Closing of the transaction, which is subject to a definitive asset purchase agreement and certain other conditions, is expected within the next 60 days.

The company said the transaction also involves consulting services, a non-compete agreement, the assumption of certain liabilities and contracts, and the issuance of an option for 100,000 shares of stock.
Phillips generated sales of approximately $53 million in 1996 from a broad line of woven jacquards, prints and velvets with innovative designs.
